description: Simulate realistic website traffic with human-like behavior. Supports any website, YouTube, Etsy, Behance, and more.

blockResources.description: Additional URL patterns to block for faster page loads. Common ad and tracking URLs are blocked by default. Not applied on YouTube pages.
blockResources.title: Block Resource Patterns

crawlingLinkSelector.description: CSS selector for links to follow when crawling is enabled. Example: 'a.product-link' to follow only product links.
crawlingLinkSelector.title: Link Selector for Crawling

enableAdvancedFingerprinting.description: Randomize browser fingerprint for each session: user agent, viewport, locale, timezone, and WebGL. Makes each visit appear from a different device.
enableAdvancedFingerprinting.title: Advanced Fingerprint Randomization

enableCrawling.description: When enabled, follows links on visited pages to simulate deeper browsing sessions. Only same-domain links are followed.
enableCrawling.title: Enable Crawling

enableYoutube.description: YouTube URLs trigger video playback simulation: auto-plays videos, waits for configured duration, and handles cookie consent.
enableYoutube.title: Enable YouTube Mode

endAfterSeconds.description: Automatically stop the actor after this many seconds. Set to 0 for unlimited runtime (runs until all URLs are processed).
endAfterSeconds.title: Stop After (seconds)

maxPagesPerUrl.description: Maximum number of pages to visit per start URL when crawling is enabled.
maxPagesPerUrl.title: Max Pages Per URL

mode.description: PAGEVIEW simulates normal browsing with human-like behavior. STRESS sends rapid requests without delays.
mode.title: Mode

proxyConfiguration.description: Optional proxy settings. The actor works without proxy for most websites. Use proxy for sites that block datacenter IPs or for geographic targeting.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration

startUrls.description: URLs to visit. Supports any website, YouTube videos, Etsy shops, Behance profiles, and more.
startUrls.title: Target URLs

waitOnPage.description: Seconds to spend on each page simulating human behavior. Actual time varies ±20% for realism. Set to 0 for minimum dwell time.
waitOnPage.title: Wait on Page (seconds)

title: Traffic Generator Input
